abstract.t: [DKIM2] and its associated documents describe the DomainKeys Identified Mail v2 (DKIM2) email authentication protocol. DKIM2 is designed to address shortcomings in email authentication protocols and mechanisms released prior to DKIM2, specifically SPF [RFC7208], DKIM [RFC6376], DMARC [RFC9989], and ARC [RFC8617]. This document discusses best practices for signing, handling, and validating messages that carry DKIM2 signatures, and for interoperating with the authentication protocols and mechanisms that preceded DKIM2.
